title: Library Circulation Transfer Zoomable Treemap
goal: Build a standalone D3 explorer that renders public library circulation data as a zoomable treemap grouped by branch and genre, with breadcrumb context, stable labels, and tooltip summaries.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the skill into hierarchical layout work, testing D3 hierarchy construction, treemap sizing, label placement, and interactive drill-down in a scenario that is clearly different from both chart-table and map views.
